design_rationale:
WORKLOG task 1 (parking_licenses_and_ev_charging) — kept up to date step by step.

[Step 0 — snapshot, draw and thesis]
Occupied by task 0: parking_ext_idle_fee_schedule (credit_idle_fee_rerate_1959dfce) and parking_ext_early_cancellation_fee (sign_parking_cancellation_notice_d2378b15) — EV idle re-rating and cancellation. Claimed here, all unoccupied: parking_ext_violation_fine_schedule (credit_violation_fine_rerate_f29c2916, agent), parking_ext_storage_bundle_discount (credit_bundle_discount_a8c94fb6, agent), parking_ext_suspension_cure_payment (pay_parking_balance_59b25ecc, user) and parking_ext_privilege_restoration (restore_parking_privileges_f55d0d0b, agent). This is the last task (M = 2): after it every extended policy is claimed exactly once and no tool is spare.
Draw (scripts/draw_counts.py <diff> --task 1): {"task": 1, "key": "env_0023_multifamily_apartment_reit/parking_licenses_and_ev_charging/1", "prerequisite_problems": 3, "problems": 4, "factor_counts": [5, 4, 5, 6]}. Assignment: violation fine schedule 5, storage bundle discount 5, cure payment 4, privilege restoration 6 — the multiset {4, 5, 5, 6} equals the draw.
Thesis: surface goal = "my garage parking is suspended, restore it today". Scored core = the reinstatement fee billed with the restoration (6 factors) and, before it, the cure amount the resident pays herself (4 factors). Hidden between goal and core: the restoration rule says privileges are not restored until a payment covering the cure amount stands received; the cure rule says the cure amount is worked out only after every fine of the last three months stands at the violation fine schedule amount (the 2026-08-19 fine was billed 50.00 flat; the schedule sets 40.00) and is not worked out until the most recent monthly fee line, when posted on or after the storage start, carries its bundle credit (the 2026-09-01 fee line has none although the Large Storage Unit B5-S212 started 2026-08-20). Depth: goal -> restoration prerequisite -> cure payment -> two prerequisites (fine correction, bundle credit) -> each with its own multi-factor computation. Breadth: lease (autopay, move-in 2021-04-01, certified-funds flag, insurance), storage (monthly rent 85.00, start 2026-08-20, status), 1/3/12/24/36-month windows, license tenure (751 days), remotes, violations and reinstatement history, and negative space (the 2026-05-09 fine is outside the fine review window and stands as billed; the August fee line was posted before the storage rental started and earns no bundle credit; the reinstatement fee is not part of the cure amount).
Draft baselines and factors: fine schedule baseline = the product's flat 50.00 (correction 0.00); factors class amount (parameter, multi-source), counting window (parameter), repeat step-up (method: per-fine accrual / flat / none), warning surcharge (parameter), standing reduction (parameter, cross-difficulty lease, multi-source). Bundle baseline = 0.10 x 95.00 = 9.50; factors program rate by storage rent (parameter), lease loyalty uplift (parameter, cross-difficulty lease, multi-source), parking tenure uplift (parameter), enforcement clawback (parameter), welcome catch-up (method, multi-source: prorated by storage-active days / flat one month / none). Cure baseline = whole parking balance; factors cure scope (method, cross-difficulty lease, multi-source), prepayment months (parameter), prepayment reduction (parameter, cross-difficulty lease), prepayment fee (method, multi-source). Restoration baseline = the product's reinstatement fee 25.00; factors graduated fee, enforcement surcharge, reinstatement standing reduction (cross-difficulty lease, multi-source), household relief, handling share (parameters) and gate reactivation (method: per-remote accrual / flat / none).

[Problem-tree card]
Root: parking_ext_privilege_restoration. Edges:
(1) restoration -> cure payment: kind value_input, gate latest_payment, form state, sentence "Privileges are not restored until a payment covering the cure amount stands received on the license." (negated direction — the way a desk states that a release waits on what it rests on). Condition: a payment received today covers the cure amount. Resolving action: pay_parking_balance_59b25ecc, owner user. False at the opening: the most recent payment on the license is initial_state.parking_charges.8470a821-7ad0-41da-b58c-8fdf6595931a of 2026-06-03 (145.00) and the license is suspended with balance_due 335.00. Exactly one write of this difficulty receives a payment on a parking license (the cure payment policy's target).
(2) cure payment -> fine schedule: kind value_input, gate whole_balance, form state, sentence "The cure amount is worked out only after every fine billed on the license in the three months before the handling date stands at the amount the violation fine schedule sets." Condition: the 2026-08-19 fine carries its correction credit. Resolving action: credit_violation_fine_rerate_f29c2916 (agent). False at the opening: initial_state.parking_charges.eba6474d-d43e-4f25-bb2b-40847859bd7f.amount = 50.00, no charge reversal points at it. Only the fine schedule's correction posts a charge reversal against a fine line.
(3) cure payment -> bundle discount: kind value_input, gate prepay_fee, form state, sentence "The cure amount is not worked out until the most recent monthly fee line of the license, when it was posted on or after the start date of the lease's active storage rental, carries the storage bundle discount credit owed on it." (scope aligned in rework round 2 with the bundle rule's object, the most recent fee line) Condition: the 2026-09-01 fee line carries its bundle credit. Resolving action: credit_bundle_discount_a8c94fb6 (agent). False at the opening: initial_state.parking_charges.e2836c39-d705-4334-911b-d2df96d88cfa (95.00, posted 2026-09-01) has no bundle_discount line pointing at it while initial_state.storage_rentals.301721a8-d9bb-458e-9808-102a5d91c300.start_date = 2026-08-20 and status active. Only the bundle policy posts bundle_discount credits.
Four-point test for each sentence: explicit connective (not until / only after / not ... until); record-visible state (a payment standing received; fine lines standing at the schedule amount; fee lines carrying a bundle credit); no tool, id or code token (check_extended green); exact scope (the review window of the fine schedule is three months; the bundle sentence reaches exactly the fee lines since the storage rental started; the payment must cover the cure amount). Directions: two negated ("not restored until", "not worked out until") and one affirmative ("only after") in this task, plus the affirmative early-fee sentence of task 0 — each chosen as that desk would say it.
Topological order: fine correction and bundle credit (either order), then the cure payment, then the restoration. Parallel edges (2) and (3): the fine credit reads only fine and violation rows and lease fields; the bundle credit reads the fee line, storage, lease, fines and bundle rows; neither reads the other's write, and both lower balance_due additively, so both orders give the same rows (ids are content hashes of the arguments) and the same balance (verified in Step 5). Customer-owned problem: the cure payment (a resident's payment of her own balance, run by her at the portal).

[Base-invariant card]
Fine correction (subject parking_fine): parking_evt_enforcement, eligibility one_fine_per_violation "Only one fine is billed for a given violation." (dedup) — evidence: the fine line eba6474d-d43e-4f25-bb2b-40847859bd7f with source_activity_id ef9fb916-9623-4c6d-9cab-92d89beb82c7 and charge_code violation_fine is the only fine of violation ef9fb916-9623-4c6d-9cab-92d89beb82c7; the correction is a credit, not a second fine; binding parking_charges.source_activity_id -> source_activity_id.
Bundle credit (subject parking_credit): parking_agg_household_pricing; its gate storage_active_for_bundle quotes the bundle sentence this policy supersedes (declared overwrite), so it is retired as a structured gate and its condition lives on in the extended rule ("While the lease also holds a storage rental in active status ..."); evidence: storage rental 301721a8-d9bb-458e-9808-102a5d91c300 status active, start 2026-08-20 <= fee line date 2026-09-01.
Cure payment (subject parking_payment): parking_evt_payments_and_changes, eligibility parking_payment_status "Parking payments are accepted while the license is active, suspended, notice_given or terminated." — license status suspended; binding parking_licenses.parking_license_id -> parking_license_id.
Restoration (subject parking_reinstatement): parking_suspension_rule (no structured eligibility, policy_scope). The base sentence "Privileges are restored only after the whole parking balance and the reinstatement_fee are paid." is overridden by the restoration's prerequisite sentence and the cure rule; the rest of the suspension rule (suspension trigger, limits to parking) is inherited. Time facts: the license has been suspended since the July fee went more than 30 days past due; no time gate applies to any of the four writes.

[Business-object card]
License 476b924f-2cc8-4e88-ad3d-a519e7e2f7fb (Structured Garage Space 5G-041, plate 5HXL902, suspended, balance 335.00 = July, August, September fees 3 x 95.00 + the 2026-08-19 fine 50.00). Fine object: fine line eba6474d-d43e-4f25-bb2b-40847859bd7f of violation ef9fb916-9623-4c6d-9cab-92d89beb82c7 (expired tag, own plate, 2026-08-19); excluded: fines 77c3c4bc-d4d0-452e-bebf-f24647ef7479 (2025-03-14) and 8b6df512-4641-487b-8272-3b0712e6a41a (2026-05-09), outside the three-month review window, which stand as billed but count as other fines in the counting window. Bundle object: fee line e2836c39-d705-4334-911b-d2df96d88cfa (posted 2026-09-01, after the storage start); excluded: 96626bfe-0834-4036-9de6-ced22d7c2853 (posted 2026-08-01, before the storage started) and all earlier lines. Cure: whole balance after the two credits; charges of the last month (the September fee) left out; the prepayment rests on the reinstatement fee of 2025-11-20 (b5c56b2e-998e-4068-90be-697ed8478336). Restoration: fee line written by the restoration tool; the extra remote line 69c1fe66-94f4-469f-8781-d96ce7eccfc2 counts as a remote, the tag replacement line a8c366fc-c207-471f-b796-cd8653327089 does not.

[Step 1 — policies written: rule <-> compute sweep and overrides]
parking_ext_violation_fine_schedule (state_due, subject parking_fine, refs [parking_evt_enforcement]); override of "Any other violation is a warning ... then a fine of violation_fine_amount while fewer than fines_before_tow fines are on record, and then a tow." by the extended sentence that keeps the warning/fine/tow ladder and sets the fine amount to the scheduled fine (base gives 50.00 on this world, the schedule 40.00). The dedup gate one_fine_per_violation and the tow, abandoned-vehicle and storage-in-space clauses stay inherited. Every factor sentence is quoted by its binding; the reverse sweep claims "fines billed earlier stand as billed" (fines_in_review_window), "Warnings and fines on record are counted over the default_window_months months" (the counting window's baseline) and "The scheduled fine is the class amount plus the repeat step-up plus the warning surcharge, less the standing reduction, and never below zero" (scheduled_fine).
parking_ext_storage_bundle_discount (state_due, subject parking_credit, refs [parking_agg_household_pricing]); override of the base bundle sentence (base gives 9.50, the program 17.29); this also retires the structured gate storage_active_for_bundle whose condition is that sentence, and the extended rule restates the storage-active condition plus the fee-day rule ("a fee line posted before the storage rental started earns none"). The earliest-started-permit clause, the no-stacking clause and the month-not-active clause of household pricing stay inherited. Order/base: the uplifts and clawback add to the program rate (additive, never below zero), the welcome catch-up acts on the product of rate and posted fee, one rounding at the end.
parking_ext_suspension_cure_payment (on_request, subject parking_payment, refs [parking_evt_payments_and_changes, parking_suspension_rule]); override of the suspension rule's "Privileges are restored only after the whole parking balance and the reinstatement_fee are paid." by its own definition of the cure amount (base: 335.00 + 25.00 on the opening world; the cure rule 255.45 at handling time). Inherited: payments accepted while suspended; oldest-first application; deposit application only at final accounting. Carries two prerequisite sentences, one per edge, nothing else about them.
parking_ext_privilege_restoration (on_request, subject parking_reinstatement, refs [parking_suspension_rule, parking_evt_fees]); overrides: the same suspension sentence, replaced by its prerequisite sentence, and the parking_evt_fees sentence on remote/tag/swap/reinstatement fees, restated with the reinstatement fee set by this rule (base 25.00; rule 77.77). Inherited: suspension trigger, suspension limited to parking, fees posting while suspended.
Labels (revised in rework round 2): fine_repeat_step_up (per-fine accrual / single flat step / none), bundle_welcome_catchup (prorated catch-up by storage-active days / flat one-month catch-up / none), restoration_gate_reactivation (per-remote accrual / single flat charge / none), cure_scope (which lines the amount is computed over), cure_prepay_fee (which fee the prepayment is measured in) change how a quantity is computed (restoration_handling_share is a parameter since rework round 2); every parameter factor selects a value from its policy's params or a tier parameter. Ladders are disjoint as stated and no two tiers share an outcome.

[Step 2 — capability contract cards]
credit_violation_fine_rerate_f29c2916 (agent/write): one charge_reversal credit pointing at a fine line and its violation (source_parking_charge_id, source_activity_id), balance lowered; receipt credit_id, parking_license_id, source_activity_id, source_parking_charge_id, charge_code, credit_amount, posted_on, resulting_parking_balance.
credit_bundle_discount_a8c94fb6 (agent/write): one bundle_discount credit pointing at a monthly fee line, balance lowered; receipt credit_id, parking_license_id, source_parking_charge_id, charge_code, discount_amount, posted_on, resulting_parking_balance.
pay_parking_balance_59b25ecc (user/write): one payment_received line with the resident's instrument and a newly issued confirmation number (a return value, not a parameter), balance lowered; receipt payment_id, parking_license_id, payment_amount, payment_method, confirmation_number, received_on, resulting_parking_balance. payment_method is an Enum listing all eight schema literals with their situations.
restore_parking_privileges_f55d0d0b (agent/write): status suspended -> active and one reinstatement_fee line billed, balance raised; receipt parking_license_id, status, fee_line_id, reinstatement_fee, posted_on, resulting_parking_balance.
None checks status, balance, payments or any prerequisite; all events stay inside parking (check_task_tools: TASK TOOL CONTRACT OK for 6 tools).

[Step 3 — world]
Customer (phone 480-555-0193, SSN 5647, DOB 1991-11-02); lease 5-104 (move-in 2021-04-01 = 2002 days, autopay true, certified_funds_only false, insurance true, rent_discount_program none, balance 0.00 — no lease obligation); storage B5-S212 Large Storage Unit (5x10), active since 2026-08-20, rent 85.00 (its own ledger is settled and outside this task); license 5G-041 suspended, balance 335.00. Ledger 42 rows: 20 monthly fees 2025-02..2026-09 (95.00 each), 16 payments (autopay on the 3rd; the 2025-10 payment missed; a 215.00 debit card payment on 2025-11-20 that settled October, November and the 25.00 reinstatement fee of that day; nothing after 2026-06-03), 3 fines (2025-03-14, 2026-05-09, 2026-08-19 — the last one open), the extra remote (45.00, 2025-06-12), a tag replacement (15.00, 2025-07-08, near-miss for remotes) and the 2025-11-20 reinstatement fee. Activity: warnings 2025-02-02 and 2026-04-11, fine-level violations 2025-03-14, 2026-05-09, 2026-08-19 (each level consistent with the base 365-day escalation at its date), guest pass 2026-07-04 (near-miss for violation counts). Near-misses by factor: the 2025-03-14 fine (outside 12 months, inside 24: decides the counting-window factor), the 2025-02-02 warning (outside 12 months), the 2026-08-01 fee line (before the storage start; it earns no credit of its own, only the catch-up days of 08-20..08-31 ride on the September credit), the tag line, the guest pass, and the 2026-08-19 fine sitting just outside the one-month cure window. Automatic clauses: suspension already applied (July fee > 30 days past due); fees keep posting while suspended (September fee present); no guest-pass, tow or fee-lock obligation; storage and lease carry nothing due. No stale cache: balance_due equals the ledger.

[Step 4 — persona]
A friendly, time-pressed dental hygienist on her lunch break. Volunteered: phone, the dead gate remote, and what a neighbour said about suspensions, and the wish to have the garage parking restored today (rework round 2: no longer volunteering a payment or an unpaid balance) — all consistent with initial_state (status suspended, no payment since 2026-06-03). Given only when asked: SSN, DOB, email, space and plate, the storage unit (only if asked about other rentals), autopay intentions. Passive reactions: goes along with whatever the agent says it is doing on her parking account; if the agent says a payment from her is needed, pays by debit card herself when handed the payment, with the license, the stated amount and debit card; accepts the reinstatement fee; ends the call when the agent confirms the privileges are restored. No mention of fines, credits or the bundle; no ask of her own beyond the restoration; her last reaction answers the last gold action.

[Step 5 — verification run]
Scratch evaluator (check_compute.build_env/eval_compute on the handling-time world) — fine schedule, step 8: class 25.00, window 24, other fines 2 -> 20.00, warnings 1 -> 5.00, standing 10.00, scheduled 40.00, result 10.00; per factor: class -> 0.00, window -> 15.00, step-up -> 30.00, warning -> 15.00, standing -> 0.00; all at once -> 0.00. Bundle, step 10 (after step 8): fee line 95.00 of 2026-09-01 covered; rate 0.12 + 0.03 + 0.02 - 0.04 = 0.13; welcome catch-up 1 + 12/30 = 1.4; result 17.29; per factor: 14.63, 13.30, 14.63, 22.61, 12.35; all at once 9.50. Cure, step 12: balance 307.71, left out 95.00, prepayment months 0.55, prepayment fee 77.71, result 255.45; per factor: scope 350.45, months 212.71, reduction 270.99, fee 264.96; all at once 307.71; prerequisite sensitivity: without the fine correction 265.45, without the bundle credit 282.25. Restoration, step 14: 50.00 + 15.00 + 15.00 + 12.7725 - 10.00 - 5.00 = 77.77; per factor: 52.77, 62.77, 62.77, 87.77, 82.77, 65.00; all at once 25.00; without the cure payment 69.35. (Figures as of rework round 2.) Order check: gold with the fine and bundle pairs swapped replays to the same hash 1ed83475811938397d00b06ddb71498cdc8f450283f1fc6c0e7f94c5e39a3f0c and balance 130.03 (rework round 2).
Gates run (--task 1): EXTENDED OK; TASK TOOL CONTRACT OK; REPLAY OK (15 actions, closure 52 = initial 52); SOLVABILITY OK (4 calls, 3 structured gates); COMPUTE OK (4 computations, 20 factors, 5 cross-difficulty, 72 history rows, 61 branches); GROUNDING OK; SCOPE OK.

[Step 6 — evaluation and closure]
Reads: profile, verification, licenses, lease, storage rentals, parking charges, parking activity — the storage read and the charges read reveal the two unmet cure prerequisites, and the charges read shows that no payment stands for the restoration; together they reach every row a factor rests on (lease fields for the four cross-difficulty factors, storage fields for rate, welcome, prepayment fee and relief). Writes in topological order: fine correction and bundle credit (agent), the customer's payment (unlock by agent, call by user), the restoration (agent). Closure: fine schedule -> credit_violation_fine_rerate_f29c2916 -> step 8 credit_amount 10.00; bundle -> credit_bundle_discount_a8c94fb6 -> step 10 discount_amount 17.29; cure -> pay_parking_balance_59b25ecc -> step 12 payment_amount 255.45; restoration -> restore_parking_privileges_f55d0d0b -> step 14 reinstatement_fee 77.77 -> status active. Negative space: the 2025-03-14 and 2026-05-09 fines are not corrected (outside the review window); the August fee earns no bundle credit (posted before the storage start); the reinstatement fee is not added to the cure.
Solvability vs GT: step 8 cites one_fine_per_violation bound through the fine's source_activity_id; step 10 cites the retired storage gate with the storage row; step 12 cites parking_payment_status bound to the license; step 14 cites parking_suspension_rule (policy_scope) and prior_step:12. Conversation walk: phone -> profile; SSN -> verified; reads; the restoration rule sends the agent to the cure payment, the cure rule to the fine and the bundle; two credits; the agent states 255.45 and hands over the payment; Alisha pays by debit card; the agent restores and states the 77.77 fee; she accepts and hangs up — one frozen_time, no external wait.
Draft recomputation from the visible context (KB prose of the four rules, tool schemas, lookup returns, persona): restoration waits on a cure payment; the cure waits on the three-month fines and the post-storage fee lines; the ledger shows one fine (2026-08-19) and one fee line (2026-09-01) outstanding; the schedule and program give 40.00/10.00 and 17.29; the cure rule gives 255.45; after the payment the restoration rule gives 77.77 — the same objects, order and numbers as gold. Easiest mistakes: correcting the 2026-05-09 fine too; crediting the August fee line; counting fines over 12 instead of 24 months; counting the guest pass or the tag line; paying the whole 307.71 (or 335.00 before the credits); measuring the prepayment in 95.00; restoring before the payment; adding the reinstatement fee to the cure.

[Manual values gates — task 1]
Length/breadth: goal -> restoration -> cure payment -> {fine correction, bundle credit}; each edge's removal changes a scored value (69.35, 265.45, 282.25). The customer-owned write (her payment) is genuinely hers and synchronous. Need and simulator boundary: object (the suspended 5G-041 license), timing (today), authorisation (she pays; the agent restores and may make the corrections), a write not a quote. Opening chronology: the suspension she heard about is consistent with the world; the credits, the payment and the restoration exist only after gold. Authoritative facts: status, balances and violations are system records; the persona asserts none beyond her observation of a dead remote and a neighbour's remark. Prerequisite sentences: four-point test passed; state form used for all three edges; directions chosen per desk (a restoration or a quote "is not ... until", a figure "is worked out only after"). Rule/compute equivalence swept both ways. Factors: every baseline is exactly what its baseline paragraph states; all 20 factors move their result on this world; the near-misses listed in Step 3 are present and excluded by the rules alone.

[Difficulty-level closing]
M = 2 tasks cover all six extended policies (task 0: idle schedule, early cancellation fee; task 1: fine schedule, bundle program, cure payment, restoration) and all six task tools, pairwise disjoint; every policy fires in exactly one computation and lands on its GT call; no tool is spare, no handoff is in any gold, and each task has its customer-owned write (the notice; the payment).

[Revision — quantity names] Symptom: the fine schedule and the restoration rule both named a quantity "standing reduction", so a rendered factor document stripped of its policy id would attach to two computations. Root cause: quantity named after the evidence (standing) rather than the act. Change: renamed to "fine standing reduction" in the fine schedule and "reinstatement standing reduction" in the restoration rule (rule, compute_basis quotations and factor traces); bindings and numbers unchanged. Re-run: all per-task and final gates green.

[Rework round 2 — response to audits/policy_task/parking_licenses_and_ev_charging (_difficulty.md, 1.md)]
Finding 1 / C-2b, C-2c, C-2d (no honest method factor in the fine, bundle and restoration computations). Root cause: the tiers of fine_counting_window, bundle_welcome_multiplier and restoration_handling_share only put a different constant (window length, multiplier, share rate) into one fixed formula. Changes:
- fine_counting_window relabelled parameter (values K(window_after_suspension_months) / K(window_new_license_months) / K(default_window_months)). fine_repeat_step_up becomes the honest method: two or more other fines -> the step-up accrues per fine (repeat_step_per_fine 10.00 x the number of other fines); exactly one -> a single flat repeat_step_single 15.00; none -> no step-up (params repeat_step_many/one replaced). Gold unchanged: 2 other fines -> 20.00, scheduled 40.00, correction 10.00; counting-window baseline now 15.00 (one other fine -> flat 15.00), step-up baseline 30.00.
- bundle_welcome_multiplier replaced by bundle_welcome_catchup (method): first bundled line with the storage started under 60 days ago -> prorated catch-up 1 + min(1, storage-active days before the fee line / catchup_month_days 30); storage started 60+ days ago -> flat one-month catch-up (1 + catchup_full_months); otherwise none. A second overwrite declares the base sentence "The bundle discount does not stack with any other parking discount and is not posted for a month in which the storage rental was not active on the fee charge day." replaced by the extended sentence that keeps no-stacking and no credit against an inactive month's fee line and carries the catch-up on the first covered line. On this world: 12 storage-active days (2026-08-20..08-31) -> factor 1.4 -> credit 17.29 (was 24.70).
- restoration_handling_share relabelled parameter (values latest_payment x K(cure_share_high) / x K(cure_share_mid) / 0). restoration_gate_reactivation becomes the honest method: two or more remotes -> accrues per remote (remote_reactivation_each 7.50 x remotes); exactly one -> single flat remote_reactivation_single 10.00; none -> no charge. Gold: 2 remotes -> 15.00 (unchanged).
Resulting counts: fine 4 parameter + 1 method, bundle 4 + 1, cure 2 + 2, restoration 5 + 1; draw multiset {5, 5, 4, 6} unchanged.
Finding 2 (SOURCE-CHAIN RED, persona named the cure payment). user_scenario no longer asks to pay, no longer says she is "ready to pay whatever the rules say" or that her parking went unpaid; the payment is only a passive reaction ("If the agent tells you that a payment from you is needed, you make it yourself on the spot ... with your Visa debit card"), so the restoration<-cure edge is discovered from the restoration rule's prerequisite sentence. no_user_hint, request_alignment and the payment step's intent evidence were updated to the new lines. T1-O1: the plural "some things ... corrected or updated" line is replaced by a generic "Whatever the agent tells you it is doing on your parking account along the way, you say that's fine". T1-O2: the expired-card remark is removed (the seeded parking payments are ach_autopay); the autopay reaction now says she will sort out her automatic payments on the portal.
Finding 3 / O-8 (68.62 vs half-up 68.63). The skip-payment figure sat on an exact half-cent tie (0.025 x 145.00). cure_share_mid is now 0.03, giving 4.35 and a skip-payment fee of 69.35 with no tie. To keep every sensitivity figure off exact ties, prepay_months_one is now 0.75 (0.5 x 77.71 would have produced 251.565, a tie). No scored value or declared sensitivity of this task now lands on an exact half cent (checked: 255.4505, 12.7725 -> 77.7725, 17.29, 10.00).
O-4 (bundle sentence wider than the bundle rule's object). The cure<-bundle prerequisite sentence now reads "The cure amount is not worked out until the most recent monthly fee line of the license, when it was posted on or after the start date of the lease's active storage rental, carries the storage bundle discount credit owed on it." — the same object the bundle rule credits; condition updated accordingly.
O-5. restoration<-cure condition: "A payment covering the cure amount stands received on the license, and it is the most recent payment on the license." (no "today").
O-1. The fine rule and the restoration rule now name their quantity one way throughout ("fine standing reduction", "reinstatement standing reduction", including the phrases that were split across folded lines); every compute_basis quotation of all six policies is verbatim (checked by script).
O-2. The fine rule's baseline sentence now reads "Other fines of the license are counted over the default_window_months months before the handling date." — it governs only the step-up count and no longer re-anchors the base escalation "on record" count, which stays inherited.
O-3. Program rate tiers are now the product's bundle_discount_with_storage_pct plus bundle_premium_high 0.05 / plus bundle_premium_mid 0.02 / the product pct, so the three tiers are distinct on every bundle product (Private Detached Garage: 0.20 / 0.17 / 0.15). Gold unchanged (0.12).

user_scenario:
You are Alisha Brennan, thirty-four, a dental hygienist who has lived in apartment 5-104 at Larkspur Scottsdale Quarter in Scottsdale, Arizona for about five and a half years. You are friendly but short on time — you are calling on your lunch break from your mobile, 480-555-0193, and you give that number first thing so they can pull up your account. For the past few weeks your garage remote has not opened the gate, and a neighbour told you that happens when parking privileges get suspended. You want your garage parking working again, today.

What you are asking for is exactly this: restore the parking privileges on your garage space so the gate opens again, today. You are not asking for anything else — no refunds, no disputes, no changes to your space or your car — and you do not raise any other part of your account. Whatever the agent tells you it is doing on your parking account along the way, you say that's fine; you just want the gate working. If the agent tells you that a payment from you is needed, you make it yourself on the spot through the resident portal with your Visa debit card when the agent sets it up and hands it to you, entering the parking license the agent names, the amount exactly as the agent states it, and debit card as the way you are paying.

You only share details when asked. To confirm your identity you give the last four of your Social Security number, 5647, and if they need one more detail, your date of birth, November 2, 1991; your email, alisha.brennan53@outlook.com, only if they specifically ask for it. If asked about the parking, it is garage space 5G-041 and your car's plate is 5HXL902. If asked whether you rent anything else from the community, you mention you started renting a storage unit, B5-S212, in August. You do not remember your parking balance or any individual charges, and if asked you say you'd rather the agent read them from the account. If the agent asks whether you want to set up automatic payments again, you say you'll sort out your automatic payments on the portal yourself later this week.

When the agent tells you there is a reinstatement fee that comes with restoring the privileges, you say okay. Once the agent confirms that your parking privileges are restored and the gate remote will work again, you thank them and end the call.
